stem: Based on the H-R diagram, which type of star could have a surface temperature of 3,000 K and be 100 times brighter than the sun?
visual_elements: Hertzsprung-Russell diagram showing Luminosity (L_Sun) vs Spectral Class with labeled regions: Supergiants, Giants, Main-sequence stars, White dwarfs, and a marked Sun point, and temperature values 25,000, 10,000, 6,000, and 3,000 K on top
